breadcrumbs.name: PVC Vs Wood Vs PLA Hotel Key Cards

summary: This comparison helps hospitality teams decide which hotel card material fits scale, sustainability goals and guest experience before premium samples start consuming time.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
PVC - High-volume standard hotel issue - Practical, scalable and familiar

faq.question: Should hotels begin with wood or PLA if sustainability is the goal?
faq.answer: Only after the baseline compatible card path is already clear. The safer route is to prove compatibility first, then test whether wood or PLA adds enough brand value.

faq.question: Is PVC still a reasonable hotel card choice?
faq.answer: Yes. PVC remains the practical baseline in many hospitality rollouts, especially where scale, cost control and consistent handling matter most.
